title: OfferSearchRequest
description: Contract for smart search input. Mirrors DealsSeeker.Shared.Contracts.Offers.SearchOffersRequest. Spec IDs: OFFERS.SEARCH.001, OFFERS.SEARCH.SMART.001, APP.LOCALIZATION.001

query.description: Empty string is allowed and triggers pre-search ordering in the API.

locale.description: Selected app language/locale used for multilingual dictionary resolution.

favoritesOnly.description: Optional filter that limits the result set to offers saved by the current authenticated user.
